brief: Prioritise Oakhurst Point for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure (MG-023). Review open work orders against the asset to re-prioritise outstanding work affecting the unit's ability to shed heat, ensuring categories 1 to 3 are completed before the event begins (SOP-016). If the detailed inspection is overdue, bring it forward in preference to accepting the exposure (REG-042).
